prompt:
Redraw the attached concept as a production turnaround for image-to-3D generation.
Output a SINGLE separate square image exactly 1024x1024 for the requested view. The other FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK, RIGHT SIDE views will be requested separately; never make a collage.
Strict orthographic projection, no perspective, camera at mid-height of the object, object centered.
Identical pose, proportions, scale and colors across the turnaround; bottom of the base on image y=920 of 1024 in every view.
Whole object including base visible, nothing cropped, at least 10% margin on every side.
Plain uniform mid-gray background RGB(128,128,128), no gradient, no floor, no cast shadows, soft even frontal lighting,
no rim light, no ambient occlusion darkening, no depth of field.
Style: stylized tabletop miniature, matte hand-painted resin look, large simplified forms, readable silhouette,
low-poly friendly: remove chainmail rings, engravings, tiny emblems and individual small feathers.
Keep 2-3 main colors plus one accent. No text, logos or labels.
Thin physical elements must be at least 2% of image width thick.
Neutral circular low dark charcoal stone base, flat smooth top, no cobbles, no colored team ring. View the disk precisely edge-on so no top ellipse is visible. Horizontal shoulder and base lines.

EDIT TARGET: the attached front view. Keep exact face, pose, sword location, crown, diamond chest badge, armor shapes and colors. Change only these defects: (1) replace the visible small chainmail blocks at BOTH inner elbows with one smooth dark cloth panel, no scales or repeated tiny geometry anywhere; (2) reduce the WHOLE figure plus sword plus base so the sword tip is at y=110 and bottom of base at y=920 on a 1024 square, leaving clean margins; (3) replace all background with a perfectly flat solid RGB 128 gray without a floor or gradient; (4) make the base a very thin flat circular disk viewed strictly edge-on, with the top surface invisible and the base lower edge perfectly horizontal. Exact FRONT orthographic projection. One figure only. No added detail.
